build: chain-1 (identical code to guard-1; only the footer stamp was renamed afterwards)

probe.threshold: garment vertex or triangle-centre sample > 0.3 mm inside skin (nearest CPU-skinned Body triangle, outward normal)
probe.browser: headless Google Chrome 155 via raw CDP, own profile, one tab
probe.sampling: hold 36 frames sampled every 12 (3), release, rebound 60 frames every 12 (5, API combos: 60/12), settle 300 frames then 1 sample; steps via namiStudio.step(1/60) with page paused
probe.conventions: LEFT = aStrap/aPanel side +1 = app region chest-left = world +x (character left, screen-RIGHT in the front/torso view); RIGHT = side -1 = world -x. Combo L/R dirs applied literally in world coordinates (+x for L outward). Drag angles: 0=screen right, 90=screen up (dy=-sin).
measurementAdjustments: renderer.render stubbed to a no-op for the matrix cases (GL draw only; garments.apply()/guard, solver, rig.update and probe are untouched and run on every step); real render restored for the screenshots
window.requestAnimationFrame throttled to 1 call/s (page paused; avoids redundant background apply()+render frames)
real pointer/touch events via CDP Input.dispatchMouseEvent / Input.dispatchTouchEvent (trusted=true) for touch and tissue cases; combos are API-driven (__comboStart)
probe.touchViewport: 390x844 dsf2 mobile + touch emulation, drag 120 px, 15 move steps; reloaded + probe reloaded; desktop 1440x1060 dsf1 restored afterwards
probe.tissueMode: #grab / #squeeze, press on cup centre face (aPanel side), 150 px drag, real mouse; tissueDisplacementMmAtHold = |chest-region displacement| from namiStudio.diagnostics() at hold

tissue.rerunNote: right-side tissue cases re-run (identical procedure) to record chest-right displacement; first run truncated diag string
